hierarchy_composition.evidence: desktop_fold.png squint: the 36rem mosaic (6 panes; rust/orange tanks in cols 1-3; CSS filter saturate(.86) brightness(.97)) is still the first mass; the 57.6px navy h1 is second; the filled hero button is third. Header Request a quote is correctly ghosted so the desktop fold no longer has two identical filled buttons. Place strip is one line. Uses is a hollow 5/6. Chairman is another hollow 5/6 with Jha orphaned. Mobile 375: one mosaic pane but filled hero btn and filled bar quote both on first screen. Tablet 768-1023: one-pane collapse only at 767px while 5/6 hero starts at 1024px.
strengths: Desktop hero is a real 5/6 split with one filled Request a quote and mosaic as companion.
Header CTA is ghosted; desktop fold no longer shows two identical filled quote buttons.
Plant identity is a single place line, not a fake stat bar.

issues.problem: Previous orange-wins-squint issue is only partly fixed. saturate(.86) still leaves the LABSA tank panes as the first-blink mass; the navy h1 is second, not first.
issues.fix: Set .shot .pane img{filter:saturate(.58) brightness(.93)}. Add a 22 percent navy overlay on tank panes only.

issues.problem: A 5/6 split with a display h2 on the left and only three short bullets in columns:2 on the right leaves a large empty field.
issues.fix: Remove columns:2 on .uses at 768px+. Render the three uses as a single-column list, max-width:36ch, li padding:12px 0, border-top:1px solid var(--line).

issues.problem: .cols puts Chairman Binay Chandra Jha in the left 5 cols and a single Directors link in the right 6 cols, so the band is about 70 percent empty paper.
issues.fix: Do not use .cols here. One column, max-width:62ch: kicker Chairman, h2 Binay Chandra Jha, then the body and the about link. Padding-block:var(--s7) only.

issues.problem: One-pane collapse only runs at max-width:767px, but .hero .wrap stays one column until 1024px.
issues.fix: Move the one-pane rules from max-width:767px to max-width:1023px. Show the 3-column mosaic only when the hero is actually 5/6.

issues.problem: The dual-filled-quote issue is fixed on desktop but reincarnated on small screens: in-hero filled Request a quote and the fixed bar filled Request a quote are both visible on the first viewport.
issues.fix: @media (max-width:1023px){ .hero .cta .btn{display:none} } Keep See specification. Let .bar be the only filled quote control below the 5/6 breakpoint.
